zh.hero_sub: 把喜欢的创意，写进你的 AI Passport
zh.search_ph: 搜索玩法名字、简介或作者…
zh.empty_sub: 换个关键词或分类试试
zh.flash_hint: 刷入会覆盖设备上当前的玩法。
zh.no_firmware: 固件还没有下载，第一次刷入时会自动下载并保存，下次不用再下载。
zh.removed_note: 该玩法已从社区下架，本地仍保留了一份。
zh.welcome_title: 欢迎使用 AI Passport 玩法社区
zh.welcome_sub: 首次使用需要把玩法社区的玩法信息和图片下载到电脑上，之后不联网也能浏览。固件在第一次刷入某个玩法时下载，下载过的会保存下来，下次刷入不用再下载。
zh.path_ph: 输入一个完整的文件夹路径
zh.phase_catalog: 正在下载玩法信息和图片
zh.browse_while: 玩法信息已就绪，可以先浏览；固件会在后台继续下载。
zh.fetch_title: 正在下载这个玩法的固件…
zh.fetch_queue: 已插队到下载队列最前面…
zh.banner_incomplete: 上次更新没有完成，部分玩法还不能刷入。
zh.step_connect: 用 USB 数据线把 AI Passport 连接到电脑，然后选择设备。
zh.no_ports: 没有找到设备。请检查：① 设备已用 USB 线连到电脑；② 数据线能传数据（有些线只能充电）；③ 换一个 USB 口；④ 仍然没有时，按住 BOOT 键再插入 USB。列表会自动刷新。
zh.no_passport: 没有找到 AI Passport，下面只有其他串口设备。请插好 AI Passport，列表会自动刷新；不确定时不要选其他设备。
zh.r_not_seen: 还没有发现任何 AI Passport。请检查数据线能传数据、换一个 USB 口，或按住 BOOT 键再插入 USB。
zh.err_port_permission: 没有权限打开设备的串口。Linux 上请安装 .deb 安装包（会自动设置设备权限），然后重新插拔设备；也可以运行 sudo usermod -aG dialout $USER，注销后重新登录。
zh.err_no_device: 没有找到设备：所选的串口已经不在了。请插好设备，点"刷新"后重新选择。
zh.flash_warn: 刷入过程中请勿拔出设备或关闭本程序。
zh.flash_done_sub: 设备已自动重启，正在进入新玩法。
zh.flash_done_replug: 设备没有自动重启，请拔插一次 USB。
zh.s_library_sub: 玩法、图片和固件都保存在这里。
zh.s_data_sub: 从 AI Passport 玩法社区下载最新的玩法。固件在刷入时按需下载，并保存在玩法目录里。
zh.worker_missing: 缺失（请使用完整安装包）
zh.move_q: 要把现有的玩法一起迁移到新目录吗？
zh.move_no_sub: 新目录中没有玩法时，需要重新下载。
zh.err_network: 网络连接失败，请检查网络后重试。
zh.err_busy: 有任务正在进行，请稍后再试。
zh.err_not_empty: 新目录不是空的，请选择一个空文件夹。
zh.err_wrong_chip: 检测到的芯片不是 ESP32-C3，这不是 AI Passport。
zh.err_secure: 设备开启了安全启动或 Flash 加密，无法刷入。
zh.err_flash_size: 设备 Flash 容量不足 8 MB。
zh.err_connect: 无法连接设备。请重新插拔数据线后重试；如仍失败，按住 BOOT 键再插入 USB。
zh.err_checksum: 固件校验失败，请重新更新玩法库。
zh.err_image_chip: 该固件不是为 AI Passport (ESP32-C3) 构建的。
zh.err_no_picker: 请直接输入文件夹路径。
zh.err_rate_limited: 固件服务器繁忙，请稍后重试。
zh.err_no_firmware: 这个玩法没有可下载的固件。
zh.tools_lead: 用数据线完成安装、备份和恢复。需要蓝牙的功能请使用安卓 App。
zh.backup_lead: 把设备上现有的固件完整读出来，保存到电脑上（8 MB）。只读取，不会改动设备。刷入新玩法或恢复出厂前，可以先备份一份。
zh.b_idle_sub: 连接一台 AI Passport 后点“开始备份”；等待连接时按提示拔插一次 USB。
zh.b_backup_sub: 大约需要 1–3 分钟，请保持设备连接
zh.b_verifying_sub: 和设备上的内容逐字节比对
zh.b_done_sub: 固件已保存，并与设备上的内容核对一致。
zh.b_warn: 备份过程中请勿拔出设备。备份只读取设备，不会写入任何内容。
zh.r_busy_backup: 正在备份固件，完成后才能开始其他操作。
zh.r_busy_restore: 正在恢复出厂，完成后才能开始其他操作。
zh.restore_lead: 把 AI Passport 恢复成出厂固件。适用于刷入玩法后无法启动、反复重启，或连接电脑后很快断开的情况。
zh.restore_step1: 只连接一台需要恢复的 AI Passport
zh.restore_step2: 点击“一键恢复出厂”；等待连接时，按提示拔插一次 USB
zh.restore_confirm: 请确认电脑只连接了一台 AI Passport。开始后请勿拔线，也不要关闭本程序。
zh.r_warn: 恢复过程中请勿拔出设备或关闭本程序。
zh.r_idle_sub: 无需选择串口，程序会自动找到设备。
zh.r_replug: 如果设备没有出现，请拔插一次 USB。
zh.r_multiple: 检测到多台设备，请只保留需要恢复的那一台。
zh.r_writing_sub: 请勿拔线或关闭本程序
zh.r_done_replug: 设备没有自动重启，请拔插一次 USB。
zh.r_failed_sub: 拔插设备后可以再试一次。
zh.r_busy_flash: 正在刷入玩法，完成后才能恢复出厂。
zh.r_blank_id: 设备的身份区（序列号和密钥）是空的。出厂固件已写入，但设备可能无法联网认证，请联系 FoloToy 并提供 MAC 地址。
zh.r_unknown_id: 没有在设备的身份区找到完整的序列号和密钥。如果设备无法联网认证，请联系 FoloToy 并提供 MAC 地址。
zh.r_full: 同时备份整片 Flash（推荐，约 8 MB，多花 1–2 分钟）
zh.r_safety: 恢复时不会擦除整片 Flash，也不会改写设备的身份区（序列号和密钥）。写入前会先备份，写入后会逐段校验。
zh.restore_link: 设备无法启动？试试恢复出厂
zh.cardid_overwritten: 这个玩法覆盖了设备的身份区（序列号和密钥）。改动前的内容已备份到备份文件夹，需要时可联系 FoloToy 恢复。
zh.err_not_found: 150 秒内没有找到设备。请关闭其他串口工具，按住 BOOT 键再插入 USB 后重试。
zh.err_firmware: 内置的出厂固件校验失败，请重新安装本程序。
zh.err_backup: 读取设备备份失败，请拔插设备后重试。
zh.err_write: 写入或校验出厂固件失败。请不要拔线，直接再恢复一次。
zh.err_cardid_changed: 严重错误：设备身份区在恢复过程中发生了变化。请停止使用这台设备，并联系 FoloToy。
zh.err_not_cancellable: 已开始写入，为避免设备损坏，会等写入和校验完成。
zh.login_hero2: 变成别人拿在手里的玩法。
zh.login_same: 和网站 ai-passport.folotoy.cn 使用同一个账号。
zh.bad_phone: 请输入有效手机号，或包含国际区号的完整号码。
zh.bad_email: 请输入有效的邮箱地址。
zh.must_agree: 请先阅读并勾选同意用户服务协议和用户隐私协议。
zh.agree_post: ，未注册的账号将在首次登录时自动创建
zh.comments_empty: 还没有评论，来写第一条吧。
zh.c_ph: 说说你玩的感受，或者给作者提个建议…
zh.c_pending_note: 已提交，审核通过后公开显示。
zh.me_signin_lead: 点赞、收藏、查看安装历史。与网站使用同一个账号。
zh.me_account_sub: 手机号、邮箱、密码，在网站上修改
zh.me_settings_sub: 玩法存储目录、备份目录、语言、关于
zh.mine_note: 发布和管理玩法请使用网站创作中心。
zh.dev_lead: 用数据线把 AI Passport 接到电脑上，就能安装玩法、备份和恢复出厂。
zh.usb_none_sub: 用支持数据传输的 USB 线连接 AI Passport。
zh.usb_unknown_sub: 找到了串口，但不像是 AI Passport。
zh.my_devices_empty: 在这台电脑上安装、备份或恢复过的设备会显示在这里。
zh.ble_lead: 无线安装、蓝牙配网和编辑通行证需要用蓝牙连接设备。桌面版暂不支持蓝牙，请先用安卓 App；用数据线能做的事在「工具」页。
zh.sec_default_info: 通行证是 AI Passport 的默认玩法：显示名字、职业、头像和图片。
zh.t_edit_passport_sub: 需要用蓝牙连接，请在安卓 App 的「设备」页编辑。
zh.t_passport_back_sub: 用数据线恢复出厂，装回通行证。
zh.t_local_sub: 安装电脑里已下载的固件文件（.bin）。
zh.t_backup_sub: 把设备里的全部内容保存到电脑。
zh.t_backups_sub: 查看备份，或写回原来的设备。
zh.t_restore_sub: 装回默认玩法「通行证」，设备身份保持不变。
zh.t_installer: 安装小程序玩法安装器
zh.t_installer_sub: 用数据线装一次，之后就能用手机无线安装玩法。
zh.t_installer_wifi: 小程序玩法安装器配网
zh.t_installer_wifi_sub: 需要蓝牙：设备进入安装模式后，在安卓 App 的「设备」页连接它再设置 Wi-Fi。
zh.t_blufi_sub: 需要蓝牙：设备菜单里打开「BLUFI Setup」后，在安卓 App 里把 Wi-Fi 名称和密码发给设备。
zh.installer_missing: 玩法库里还没有小程序玩法安装器，请先更新玩法库。
zh.installer_warn: 装好后设备会进入安装模式，原有玩法和已保存的 Wi-Fi 会被清除。之后可以在手机上无线安装玩法，或在这里恢复出厂。
zh.backups_lead: 备份保存在备份目录里。写回设备只能写回原来那台设备（按 MAC 地址核对）。
zh.b_delete_q: 确定删除这个备份文件吗？同一次的报告和设备身份备份会保留。
zh.flash_agree: 我知道设备上原有的玩法和数据会被覆盖
zh.flash_agree_backup: 我知道设备上现在的内容会被这个备份替换
zh.file_hint: 必须是合并好的 ESP32-C3 固件（从 0x0 开始写入，不超过 8 MB）。
zh.batch_none: 玩法库还是空的，请先更新玩法库。

en.hero_sub: Put the ideas you love into your AI Passport
en.search_ph: Search by name, description or author…
en.flash_hint: Installing replaces the app currently on the device.
en.no_firmware: The firmware is not downloaded yet. It is downloaded and kept the first time you install, so later installs need no download.
en.removed_note: This app was removed from the community; a local copy is kept.
en.welcome_title: Welcome to the AI Passport App Library
en.welcome_sub: First, download the app info and images from the community to this computer; after that you can browse without a network. Firmware is downloaded the first time you install an app and kept, so the next install needs no download.
en.browse_while: App info is ready to browse; firmware keeps downloading in the background.
en.fetch_queue: Moved to the front of the download queue…
en.banner_incomplete: The last update did not finish; some apps cannot be installed yet.
en.step_connect: Connect your AI Passport with a USB data cable, then pick the device.
en.no_ports: No device found. Check that: ① the device is connected by USB; ② the cable carries data (some only charge); ③ another USB port helps; ④ if not, hold BOOT while plugging in USB. The list refreshes by itself.
en.no_passport: No AI Passport found; only other serial devices are listed. Plug in the AI Passport and the list refreshes by itself. Do not pick another device unless you are sure.
en.r_not_seen: No AI Passport has appeared yet. Check that the cable carries data, try another USB port, or hold BOOT while plugging in USB.
en.err_port_permission: You don’t have permission to open the device’s serial port. On Linux, install the .deb package (it sets up device access), then replug the device. Or run sudo usermod -aG dialout $USER, then log out and back in.
en.err_no_device: Device not found: the selected port is gone. Plug in the device, click Refresh and choose it again.
en.flash_warn: Do not unplug the device or quit the app while installing.
en.flash_done_sub: The device has restarted into the new app.
en.flash_done_replug: The device did not restart by itself. Unplug and replug USB once.
en.s_library_sub: Apps, images and firmware are stored here.
en.s_data_sub: Download the latest apps from the AI Passport community. Firmware is downloaded when you install an app and kept in the library folder.
en.move_q: Move the existing apps to the new folder?
en.move_no_sub: If the new folder has no apps, download them again.
en.err_network: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
en.err_busy: Another task is running. Try again later.
en.err_target: Cannot write to the selected folder.
en.err_not_empty: The new folder is not empty. Choose an empty folder.
en.err_wrong_chip: The detected chip is not ESP32-C3, so this is not an AI Passport.
en.err_secure: Secure Boot or Flash Encryption is enabled; cannot install.
en.err_flash_size: The device flash is smaller than 8 MB.
en.err_connect: Cannot connect to the device. Reconnect the cable and retry; if it still fails, hold BOOT while plugging in USB.
en.err_checksum: Firmware check failed. Update the library again.
en.err_image_chip: This firmware is not built for AI Passport (ESP32-C3).
en.err_rate_limited: The firmware server is busy. Try again later.
en.err_no_firmware: This app has no downloadable firmware.
en.tools_lead: Install, back up and restore with a USB cable. Use the Android app for features that need Bluetooth.
en.backup_lead: Read the whole firmware on the device and save it on this computer (8 MB). It only reads; the device is not changed. Make one before installing an app or restoring.
en.b_idle_sub: Connect one AI Passport and click “Start backup”; replug USB once if asked while it waits.
en.b_backup_sub: About 1–3 minutes; keep the device connected
en.b_done_sub: The firmware is saved and matches the device.
en.b_warn: Do not unplug the device during the backup. It only reads; nothing is written to the device.
en.r_busy_backup: A firmware backup is running. Wait for it to finish.
en.r_busy_restore: A factory restore is running. Wait for it to finish.
en.restore_lead: Put the factory firmware back on an AI Passport. Use it when the device will not start after installing an app, keeps rebooting, or disconnects soon after you plug it in.
en.restore_step1: Connect only the AI Passport you want to restore
en.restore_step2: Click “Restore factory firmware”; while it waits, unplug and replug USB once if asked
en.restore_confirm: Make sure only one AI Passport is connected. Do not unplug it or close the app once it starts.
en.r_warn: Do not unplug the device or quit the app during the restore.
en.r_idle_sub: No port to choose; the app finds the device by itself.
en.r_replug: If nothing happens, unplug and replug USB once.
en.r_multiple: More than one device is connected. Keep only the one to restore.
en.r_writing_sub: Do not unplug or close the app
en.r_done_replug: The device did not restart by itself. Unplug and replug USB once.
en.r_failed_sub: Replug the device and try again.
en.r_busy_flash: An app is being installed. Wait for it to finish first.
en.r_blank_id: The device identity area (serial number and keys) is empty. The factory firmware is installed, but the device may fail to sign in online. Contact FoloToy with the MAC address.
en.r_unknown_id: No complete serial number and keys were found in the identity area. If the device cannot sign in online, contact FoloToy with the MAC address.
en.r_full: Also back up the whole flash (recommended; about 8 MB, 1–2 extra minutes)
en.r_safety: The restore never erases the whole flash and never rewrites the identity area (serial number and keys). It backs up first and verifies every segment afterwards.
en.restore_link: Device will not start? Try a factory restore
en.cardid_overwritten: This app overwrote the device identity area (serial number and keys). The previous contents are in the backup folder; contact FoloToy if you need them restored.
en.err_not_found: No device was found within 150 seconds. Close other serial tools, then hold BOOT while plugging in USB and try again.
en.err_firmware: The bundled factory firmware failed its check. Reinstall the app.
en.err_backup: Reading the backup from the device failed. Replug it and try again.
en.err_write: Writing or verifying the factory firmware failed. Keep it plugged in and restore again.
en.err_cardid_changed: Serious error: the identity area changed during the restore. Stop using this device and contact FoloToy.
en.err_backup_dir: Cannot write to the backup folder.
en.err_not_cancellable: Writing has started. To protect the device it will finish writing and verifying first.
en.login_hero2: into plays people hold in their hands.
en.login_same: Same account as the website ai-passport.folotoy.cn.
en.bad_phone: Enter a valid mobile number, or the full number with its country code.
en.must_agree: Please read and agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy first.
en.agree_pre: I have read and agree to the
en.agree_post: . New accounts are created on first sign-in.
en.cc_search: Search a country, region or code
en.comments_empty: No comments yet. Be the first.
en.c_ph: How did you like it? Or suggest something to the author…
en.c_pending_note: Sent. It will show once it is approved.
en.me_signin_lead: Like and save plays, and see your install history. Same account as the website.
en.me_account_sub: Change your mobile number, email or password on the website
en.me_settings_sub: Library folder, backup folder, language, about
en.mine_note: To publish and manage plays, use the creator center on the website.
en.dev_lead: Connect AI Passport to this computer with a USB cable to install plays, back it up or restore it.
en.usb_none_sub: Connect AI Passport with a USB cable that carries data.
en.usb_unknown_sub: A serial port was found, but it doesn't look like an AI Passport.
en.my_devices_empty: Devices you install, back up or restore on this computer appear here.
en.ble_lead: Wireless install, Bluetooth Wi-Fi setup and editing the Passport need a Bluetooth connection. The desktop app doesn't support Bluetooth yet, so use the Android app for these. Everything you can do with a cable is on the Tools tab.
en.sec_default_info: Passport is AI Passport's default play: it shows a name, job title, avatar and picture.
en.t_edit_passport_sub: Needs Bluetooth. Edit it on the Device tab of the Android app.
en.t_passport_back_sub: Restore the default play with a USB cable to get Passport back.
en.t_local_sub: Install a firmware file (.bin) saved on this computer.
en.t_backup_sub: Save everything on the device to this computer.
en.t_backups_sub: View backups, or write one back to its device.
en.t_restore_sub: Reinstall the default play Passport. The device's identity stays as it is.
en.t_installer_sub: Install it once with a USB cable, then install plays from your phone wirelessly.
en.t_installer_wifi_sub: Needs Bluetooth. When the device is in install mode, connect to it on the Device tab of the Android app and set up Wi-Fi.
en.t_blufi_sub: Needs Bluetooth. Open "BLUFI Setup" in the device menu, then send the Wi-Fi name and password from the Android app.
en.installer_missing: Play Installer isn't in your library yet. Update the library first.
en.installer_warn: After installing, the device goes into install mode and its existing plays and saved Wi-Fi are cleared. You can then install plays wirelessly from your phone, or restore the default play here.
en.backups_lead: Backups are kept in the backup folder. A backup can only be written back to the device it came from (checked by MAC address).
en.b_delete_q: Delete this backup file? The report and identity copies from the same session are kept.
en.flash_agree: I understand the existing plays and data on the device will be overwritten
en.flash_agree_backup: I understand what is on the device now will be replaced by this backup
en.file_path_ph: Full path of the firmware file (.bin)
en.file_hint: It must be a merged ESP32-C3 image, written from 0x0, at most 8 MB.
en.batch_none: The library is empty. Update it first.
